name: OmaLink
author: OmaLink contributors
description: Native Android phone integration for Omarchy, powered by KDE Connect.

barWidget.description: Connect an Android phone and access it from the Omarchy bar.

schema.label: Notification sources
schema.description: Comma-separated app names or Android package names. A notification pops up when one of these appears in its app name or package. Clear the list to allow every notification.

schema.label: Notification popups
schema.description: Off keeps matching notifications listed in the panel without desktop popups.

schema.label: Media controls
schema.description: Show the phone's active media player in the panel. Off hides the section entirely.
